name: unifi-console-mcp
description: Read, audit and (optionally) change your UniFi Network from Claude, with a preview-then-confirm flow for every change.
long_description: UniFi Console connects Claude to your own UniFi console over your local network. It covers the documented Integration API plus the controller and UniFi OS APIs: system log, firewall policy hit counts, PoE budget, switch ports, access review, backups and support files. Read tools are always safe. Configuration changes are off by default; when you turn them on, every change is previewed first and applied only after you approve it, with an audit journal and secrets always redacted. Everything runs on your computer and talks only to your console.

tools.name: unifi_console_access_review
tools.description: Who and what can access the console: admin accounts, custom roles and API keys (keys masked).

tools.name: unifi_console_app_block
tools.description: Preview, then apply, changes to the console's application blocks (Settings > Security > Simple App Blocking).

tools.name: unifi_console_backup
tools.description: List, create or download UniFi OS console backups (whole console, not just the Network app).

tools.name: unifi_console_call_operation
tools.description: Call one spec operation on the console: file downloads and safe writes.

tools.name: unifi_console_client
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to one known client: alias, note, fixed IP and Local DNS record.

tools.name: unifi_console_client_command
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a command for one client: block, unblock, reconnect or forget.

tools.name: unifi_console_client_group
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to the console's client groups (named sets of client MAC addresses used by policies).

tools.name: unifi_console_data_retention
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to how long the console keeps statistics and events (Control Plane > Network data retention).

tools.name: unifi_console_describe_operation
tools.description: Show an operation's parameters, request-body schema, access level and description from the spec.

tools.name: unifi_console_device
tools.description: Preview, then apply, an action on ONE UniFi device (access point, switch, gateway).

tools.name: unifi_console_doh
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to the gateway's DNS over HTTPS (DoH) setting.

tools.name: unifi_console_dynamic_dns
tools.description: Preview, then apply, the creation, update or deletion of a Dynamic DNS entry on the gateway.

tools.name: unifi_console_firewall_policy
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to one custom zone-based firewall policy.

tools.name: unifi_console_firewall_policy_hits
tools.description: List zone-based firewall policies with hit counts and last-hit time, for audits.

tools.name: unifi_console_gateway_config
tools.description: What the controller actually sent the gateway, read from a console support file, and whether it matches.

tools.name: unifi_console_list_operations
tools.description: Search the UniFi OpenAPI spec for operations (undocumented controller / UniFi OS APIs, the Integration API and the cloud Site Manager API).

tools.name: unifi_console_logging_levels
tools.description: Preview, then apply, the logging level (warn or debug) of the Network application's services: device, mgmt, sdn, system.

tools.name: unifi_console_network
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to a LAN/VLAN network.

tools.name: unifi_console_network_list
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to the console's network lists (port, address and domain lists used by firewall policies).

tools.name: unifi_console_poe_overview
tools.description: PoE budget for one switch plus the site's power supervisors (watchdogs that power-cycle ports).

tools.name: unifi_console_port_forward
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to the console's port forwards (internet-to-LAN rules).

tools.name: unifi_console_qos_rule
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to the console's QoS rules (the dashboard's QoS widget; Traffic Management objects use unifi_console_traffic_object instead).

tools.name: unifi_console_read_operation
tools.description: Run one read-only spec operation on the console and return its data.

tools.name: unifi_console_session_status
tools.description: Check the connection and report which account the server runs as, what it may do, and session facts.

tools.name: unifi_console_static_dns
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to the gateway's Local DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, SRV, TXT).

tools.name: unifi_console_support_file
tools.description: Generate a support file and (for the console) download it to disk.

tools.name: unifi_console_switch_port
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to ONE port of ONE switch.

tools.name: unifi_console_switch_port_detail
tools.description: Live per-port state for a switch: link, STP state/role, flaps, errors, PoE and optionally LLDP.

tools.name: unifi_console_syslog
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to the console's remote syslog setting (where logs are sent and which categories).

tools.name: unifi_console_system_log
tools.description: Query the UniFi System Log (the Network app's 'System Log' page), with templates already filled in.

tools.name: unifi_console_traffic_object
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to the console's traffic objects (Traffic Management: bandwidth limits and priority, schedules, internet blocking and routing for networks or clients).

tools.name: unifi_console_wan
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to the WAN network settings.

tools.name: unifi_console_wifi
tools.description: Preview, then apply, a change to a Wi-Fi network (SSID).

console_host.title: Console address
console_host.description: IP address or hostname of your UniFi console, for example 192.168.1.1. Leave blank to use the UNIFI_LOCAL_HOST system environment variable.

api_key.title: Integration API key
api_key.description: UniFi Network Integration API key (Network > Settings > Control Plane > Integrations). Used for the documented Integration API. Blank uses the UNIFI_MCP_API_KEY system variable.

site_manager_api_key.title: Site Manager API key
site_manager_api_key.description: Cloud key from unifi.ui.com > API (not the Integration API key). Used read-only for every console on the UI account: hosts, sites, devices, ISP metrics and SD-WAN. Blank uses the UNIFI_SITE_MANAGER_API_KEY system variable; with neither, Site Manager operations are refused.

username.title: Local admin username
username.description: Blank uses UNIFI_MCP_USERNAME. Local (not cloud) admin account. Needed with the password for the controller and UniFi OS endpoints that an API key cannot reach: system log, firewall hit counts, PoE, backups and all configuration writes.

password.title: Local admin password
password.description: Blank uses UNIFI_MCP_PASSWORD. Stored by the host in the operating system's secure storage when entered here.

site.title: Site
site.description: UniFi site name. Blank uses UNIFI_DEFAULT_SITE, then 'default'.

port.title: HTTPS port
port.description: HTTPS port of the console. Blank uses UNIFI_LOCAL_PORT, then 443.

verify_ssl.title: Verify the console's TLS certificate
verify_ssl.description: true or false; blank uses UNIFI_LOCAL_VERIFY_SSL, then true. Consoles ship with a self-signed certificate. Leave on if you installed a trusted certificate or set a fingerprint below; turn off only on a network you trust.

cert_sha256.title: Pinned certificate fingerprint (SHA-256)
cert_sha256.description: Optional. SHA-256 fingerprint of the console's certificate. When set, only that certificate is accepted, which is the safe way to use a self-signed console.

enable_writes.title: Allow configuration changes
enable_writes.description: true or false; blank uses UNIFI_CONSOLE_ENABLE_WRITES, then false (read-only). When on, typed write tools can change configuration, but only for the entities listed below and only after a preview and an explicit confirm.

write_entities.title: Entities that may be changed
write_entities.description: Comma-separated list, for example 'wifi,network,firewall_policy'. Blank uses UNIFI_CONSOLE_WRITE_ENTITIES. Ignored unless writes are enabled; empty means nothing can be changed.

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: Where backups and support files are saved. Defaults to ~/.unifi-console-mcp/downloads.

journal_dir.title: Change journal folder
journal_dir.description: Where the audit journal of every confirmed change is kept. Defaults to ~/.unifi-console-mcp/journal.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR or CRITICAL. Logs go to the host's MCP log file (stderr), never to the chat.
